sloka: गाश्च स्पृशतु पादेन गुरून् परिवदेत्स्वयम् ।मित्रे द्रुह्येत सोऽत्यन्तम् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-३१॥
transliteration: gāśca spṛśatu pādena gurūn parivadetsvayam ।mitre druhyeta so'tyantam yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-31॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person who kicks the cows abuses elders and causes great offence to his friends
